name: Maharashtra Bandhkam Kamgar Yojana
des: The Maharashtra Bandhkam Kamgar Yojana (बांधकाम कामगार योजना) is a comprehensive social security and welfare scheme administered by the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MAHABOCW) under the Labour Department, Government of Maharashtra. Established on 1 May 2011 under the Building and Other Construction Workers (BOCW) Act 1996, the board provides financial, educational, medical, and social welfare benefits to registered construction workers (बांधकाम कामगार) and their families. Workers covered include masons, helpers, electricians, plumbers, painters, carpenters, tile workers, scaffolding workers, and others employed at registered construction sites in Maharashtra. As of April 2025, the scheme has benefited over 14.55 lakh workers with disbursements exceeding ₹2,146 crore. Registration, renewal, scholarship applications, and claims are all processed through the official MAHABOCW portal. The 2024–25 cycle has been extended with registration and renewal dates valid until 31 December 2026.
benefits: Educational Assistance (E04): ₹20,000/year for children pursuing Graduation or Diploma courses
Engineering Degree Scholarship (E06): ₹60,000 for Engineering Degree students
Foreign Higher Education Scholarship: ₹50,000 (one-time) for Master's/PhD abroad with 60%+ in previous exam
Sports Scholarship: For children who have participated at State, National, or International level sports
Accidental Death Benefit (F01): ₹5,00,000 financial assistance to family
Natural Death Benefit (F02): ₹2,00,000 financial assistance to family
Disability Benefit (H04): ₹2,00,000 for permanent disability due to accident
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) for all applicable benefits to Aadhaar-linked bank account
criteria: Worker must be a permanent resident of Maharashtra (domicile proof mandatory)
Worker's age must be between 18 and 60 years
Must have worked at a construction site for a minimum of 90 days in the preceding 12 months (90-day work certificate required from contractor or MAHABOCW district office)
Registration with MAHABOCW is compulsory — all benefits require an active, renewed registration
Annual registration renewal is mandatory to continue receiving benefits
For education scholarships: only the first two children of the registered worker are eligible
For E01 scholarship: child must maintain minimum 75% attendance in previous academic year
For E02 scholarship: child must score 50% or more in Class 10 or Class 12 board exams
For Foreign Education Scholarship: child must have 60%+ marks and be pursuing Master's or PhD abroad
Child must be enrolled in a government-recognized school or college
Worker must not have a gap of registration lapse — renewal ensures continued eligibility
Note (2026 update): Since February 5, 2025, data entry at taluka facilitation centres is discontinued — all registration and claims must be done online via mahabocw.in
required_documents: MAHABOCW Construction Worker Registration Card (mandatory for all benefits)
Aadhaar Card of worker and child
90-Day Work Certificate signed by contractor (or Form-E if contractor refuses)
Age Proof (Birth Certificate / School Leaving Certificate)
Income Certificate (if applicable for specific schemes)
Bank Passbook (Aadhaar-linked account for DBT) — in name of worker or child
Passport Size Photograph of worker and child
75% Attendance Certificate from school/college (for scholarship renewal)
Death Certificate and FIR copy (for accidental death benefit)
Educational Self-Declaration Form in new 2026 format (mandatory from January 2026 — old format applications are auto-rejected)
application_process: Visit the official MAHABOCW portal: https://mahabocw.in
Worker Registration: Click 'Worker Registration', enter Aadhaar-linked mobile number, complete OTP verification and fill in personal and work details
Upload 90-day work certificate signed by contractor and all required documents
Book a verification appointment at your nearest MAHABOCW district office (mandatory step post-registration)
Once registration is approved, login to portal and navigate to 'Schemes / Benefits'
Select the applicable scheme (education, marriage, medical, etc.) under your worker profile
For scholarship: fill in child's academic details, upload Bonafide Certificate, marksheet, and attendance certificate
Use the new 2026 Educational Self-Declaration format (available on mahabocw.in) — old format applications are auto-rejected
Submit the application and note the Application/Claim ID
Track application status online at mahabocw.in using registration number and district
Annual renewal of worker registration is mandatory — do not allow registration to lapse or all benefits stop
